title: Korallen-DHW-Sandbox — interactive NOAA Degree Heating Week bleaching diagnostic (P114)
description: Interactive NOAA Coral Reef Watch Degree Heating Week (DHW) bleaching sandbox, ported 1:1 from coral-reef-utac (GenesisAeon P114, v1.2.0): DHW 0-20 C-weeks with five official alert levels, the real escalating series of four documented global bleaching events (21% -> 37% -> 68% -> 84.4%), Hughes et al. 2018's 6-year return interval independently confirmed by GCRMN & ICRI 2025's 5-6 year recovery window, Guillermic et al. 2021's heat-disables-acidification-coping synergy, and Walker et al. 2023's genotype-level honesty check (bleaching resistance is not uniform and carries a real fitness cost). Also includes live WMO monitoring of the current (2026) exceptionally strong El Nino as watch context, explicitly not a claim of a confirmed fifth global bleaching event. No UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge and no invented Gamma value. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
